title: No app client can present the operator token the guarded routes require
body:
## Summary
With POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN set, every requireOperator route answers 401 to the app itself, because no client code sends the token.

## Description
requireOperator demands the token whenever the env var is set. A grep of src/lib, src/hooks and src/components for x-operator-token, operator token and Bearer finds only provider API keys. Same-origin browser calls pass only in the no-token mode. This round added six more guarded routes, so the forge panels, the icon-set panel and any MCP caller stop working on a deployment that sets the token. Fixing it is a decision on how a browser holds that credential. Anchors: src/lib/api-auth.ts:38, src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/route.ts:72.

## Flow
- Set POF_OPERATOR_TOKEN
- Submit from the forge panel
- The POST answers 401 because apiFetch sends no token
- Decide: session cookie, injected header, or loopback-only token mode

## Expected impact
An off-loopback deployment gets a working UI. A credential in the browser widens what a stolen session can do.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the guarded routes stay usable when the token is configured
Before: 0 client call sites send the token
After: not predicted; depends on the chosen credential
Method: simulation - grep only; the design choice has no figure
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence:
src/lib/api-auth.ts:38
grep of src/lib src/hooks src/components for x-operator-token|operator.?token|Bearer: provider API keys only, excluding api-auth itself

title: Footage and mesh routes accept any local file path
body:
## Summary
videoPath and meshPath go to ffmpeg and Blender with no root check, so an operator-reachable call can read any local file.

## Description
footage-gate passes videoPath to ffprobe and ffmpeg, then sends sampled frames to a remote vision provider. icon-from-mesh passes meshPath to Blender and its 400 echoes whether the path exists. Both are now operator-guarded, which narrows who can do this, but neither has an allowed root. The legitimate roots are not stated anywhere: clips may live outside the repo. Anchors: src/app/api/visual-gen/footage-gate/route.ts:41, src/app/api/visual-gen/icon-from-mesh/route.ts:69.

## Flow
- Decide the allowed roots (generated/, the UE project, an operator-chosen folder)
- Refuse a path outside them before spawning
- Test a path outside the roots

## Expected impact
A guarded caller can no longer send arbitrary local video frames to a remote model. Could refuse clips stored elsewhere today.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - the file a route reads is inside a stated root
Before: 0 of 2 routes check a root
After: 2 of 2 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the roots are an operator decision, so no gate can be written yet
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: Paid routes leave no server log of a spend or a refusal
body:
## Summary
None of the seven routes that spend, spawn or proxy upstream calls logger, so a spend or a 502 is visible only to the caller.

## Description
grep -c "logger." returns 0 for generate, generate-2d, contact-sheet, input-gate, footage-gate, icon-from-mesh and browse. A provider failure is returned to the panel and then gone, so a run of failed paid calls cannot be reconstructed on the server. Fixed means one structured line per outcome carrying provider, status and duration, never the prompt or image. Anchors: src/app/api/visual-gen/generate-2d/route.ts:99, src/app/api/visual-gen/contact-sheet/route.ts:202.

## Flow
- Add a logger line on each provider outcome
- Assert the logger spy fires on a stubbed 502 and carries no prompt text

## Expected impact
A failed paid batch can be read from the server log. Adds log volume per generation.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every paid outcome leaves a server trace
Before: 0 logger calls across 7 routes
After: 1 per paid outcome (predicted)
Method: simulation - counted by grep; the log line is not built
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: grep -c "logger\." = 0 in generate, generate-2d, contact-sheet, input-gate, footage-gate, icon-from-mesh, browse routes
instrument: a logger spy test on a stubbed provider failure, asserting one line with no prompt text

title: Generate temp input images have no cleanup in dispatch or the job stores
body:
## Summary
writeTemp puts each input image in the OS temp dir, and neither runner-dispatch nor the four job stores delete it.

## Description
runner-dispatch.ts writes pof_<provider>_in_<stamp> and one file per multiview slot. A grep for unlink, rmSync and rm( across runner-dispatch and the triposr, hunyuan, tripo and trellis job stores returns nothing. The runner modules themselves were not checked, so a delete there would close this. The file is outside this context paths. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/runner-dispatch.ts:91.

## Flow
- Check the runner modules for a delete
- Remove the temp input when the job settles
- Test that a settled stubbed job leaves no temp file

## Expected impact
Temp space stops growing by one image per submit. A recovery that re-reads the input would need it kept.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - bounded temp usage
Before: 0 delete sites in 5 files
After: 1 on job settle (predicted)
Method: simulation - grep only; runners not read
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/lib/visual-gen/runner-dispatch.ts:91
grep unlink|rmSync|rm( in runner-dispatch.ts and 4 job stores: no matches
instrument: a stubbed job asserting the temp input is gone after it settles

title: Status route imports its projection from a component module
body:
## Summary
The server status route imports projectCritique from the asset-forge component folder, so an API depends on UI code.

## Description
src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/status/route.ts:4 is the only src/app or src/lib importer of projectCritique found by grep. Moving forgeJobStatus to src/lib keeps one projection for server and client and removes the upward dependency. The module is outside this context paths. Anchors: src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/status/route.ts:4.

## Flow
- Move the pure projection to src/lib/visual-gen
- Re-export or update the component imports
- Run the status projection tests

## Expected impact
The API no longer pulls from the component tree. Touches every importer of forgeJobStatus.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - server code has no component imports
Before: 1 route imports from src/components
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the move crosses this context boundary
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a source scan of src/app/api/visual-gen for @/components imports

title: Icons list returns the whole library for a catalogId with no step
body:
## Summary
GET /icons?catalogId=x without step falls through to the unfiltered list, so a partial filter answers with every icon.

## Description
The route filters only when both catalogId and step are present, then returns all icons. The header says a filtered lookup returns only the art generated for that artifact, and a caller that dropped step would get other catalogs art with a 200. Whether any caller relies on this was not fully traced: useGeneratedImageAssets.ts matched as binary in grep and was not read. Anchors: src/app/api/visual-gen/icons/route.ts:50.

## Flow
- Trace callers that pass catalogId alone
- Answer 400, or filter by catalog
- Test the partial query

## Expected impact
A partial filter cannot show another catalog art. Could break a caller relying on the fallthrough.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a filtered query never returns unfiltered results
Before: 1 partial query shape returns all icons
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - read from the route; callers not fully traced
Result: better
Gate: contract
instrument: a route test with catalogId alone, after tracing the callers

title: Serve and listing routes repeat their helpers
body:
## Summary
dirStamp is copied in two listing routes and the MIME map in three serve routes.

## Description
assets/route.ts and icons/route.ts each define an identical dirStamp. asset, icon and image routes each define a MIME table, and the icon and image tables are identical. The generated-assets helper module is the natural home, but it was not edited because a sibling context may own it. Anchors: src/app/api/visual-gen/assets/route.ts:41, src/app/api/visual-gen/icons/route.ts:57.

## Flow
- Move dirStamp and the image MIME table beside the shared cache helpers
- Update the routes
- Run the cache revalidation suite

## Expected impact
A new image type is added once. No behaviour change expected.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one definition per helper
Before: 2 dirStamp copies; 2 identical image MIME tables
After: 1 each (predicted)
Method: simulation - counted by reading
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a grep count of dirStamp definitions, with the cache revalidation suite green

title: Context map api_surface omits both browse routes
body:
## Summary
visual-gen-core lists browse and browse/files in file_paths but not in api_surface.

## Description
context-map.json is director-owned, so this round did not edit it. The api_surface string names 12 endpoints against 14 route files. The registry map row also omits browse/files and footage-gate from its paths. Anchors: context-map.json (visual-gen-core api_surface).

## Flow
- Add the two GET endpoints to api_surface on the next context scan

## Expected impact
A reader of the map sees every endpoint. No runtime effect.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the map matches the routes
Before: 12 endpoints listed of 14 routes
After: 14 of 14 (predicted)
Method: simulation - counted; file is director-owned
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: context-map.json: visual-gen-core api_surface has 12 entries, file_paths has 14 routes
instrument: a count of api_surface entries against route files
